crossRefs.note: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand…

translations.web: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
translations.bsb: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
translations.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see
translations.asv: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
